hook: Hyderabad's minimum fell *2.6°C* in a day to 17.9°C
hook_b: Hyderabad's minimum fell *2.6°C* in a day to 17.9°C
tldr: IMD recorded 17.9°C on Thursday morning, down from 20.5°C, near the 17.6°C normal. Minimums are expected at 18-19°C and maximums 30-32°C from Nov 20 to 25, with isolated light to moderate rain in Telangana on Friday and Saturday.

beats.what: Hyderabad's mornings turned cooler, close to seasonal normal.
beats.why: Temperatures had been running nearly 3°C above normal.
beats.care: Expect cool mornings and warm afternoons through Nov 25.

facts.t: Golconda weather station in Hyderabad logged *15°C* on Nov 17; Kohir in Sangareddy hit 11.2°C.
Asifnagar and Shaikpet logged the city's lowest minimum, *17.2°C*.
